mode: capture-merge-fit-update-replan-advance loop only; no scan or overview motion
planner_truth_rule: truth is used only for scene validity and offline scoring

raised_start.method: the one warmed, wrist-constrained loop planner solves from the camera-front seed to world +0.20 m Z with the same tool orientation; the solved state is used directly as loop start and that solve is not executed as experiment motion

wrist_3_limit.method: load existing YAML into cuRobo RobotCfg, modify the in-memory JointLimits.position tensor before MotionPlannerCfg.create; IK, TrajOpt, and PRM receive the same RobotCfg

speed_rule: advance 0.020 rad when current-to-fit clearance is below 0.050 m; otherwise advance 0.050 rad

unknown_extent_rule.all_borders: transform each same-frame image-border outward direction to world, project to the horizontal plane, and extend by 0.030 m; border touches never change height
unknown_extent_rule.normal_height: highest observed point plus 0.020 m padding
unknown_extent_rule.near_camera_exception: when the same-frame highest point is within 0.030 m of the camera height, use the fixed raised-start camera height plus 0.100 m
unknown_extent_rule.shrink_rule: horizontal extensions use only current-frame flags and disappear once that edge is inside
